Tests

Fixed tests, run every so often, under the same conditions every time. That is what makes them comparable. A test never changes once it has results against it.

Strength & conditioning

The gym and everything that goes with it. Movement prep before every session, speed work alongside.

LPGA Tour averages

What the numbers look like at the top of the women's game. Use them to set the next target, not to judge today's session.

Where the targets sit

Every performance goal in the programme is a move from tour standard to top ten. The one exception is marked.

Club performance averages

Club speed and carry are the two that move everything else. Attack angle is negative for every club but the driver, which is hit on the way up.

Proximity by distance

What tour players actually leave themselves from each distance. Average proximity is the middle of the field, not the target.

Hold the camera up and see how wide the approach circles actually are. They barely change angular size from 110 yards out to 185, because the circle grows in step with the distance.

For scale, Minjee Lee's +2.02 strokes-gained approach season, the best of the ShotLink era bar Tiger in 2006: 12 ft from 100-125 in the fairway, 16.4 ft from 125-150, 20 ft from 150-175, 22.5 ft from 175-200.

Where the practice went

The programme prescribes an even split: one session long game, one session inside 100. Two-thirds of strokes come from outside 100 yards, so when the split slides it should slide towards approach, not away from it.

    Tap the flag on screen to put the target there.

    Calibration

    Everything scales off this, and it differs by phone. It is the angle across the long side of the picture, so it does not change when you turn the phone. Set it once: stand a measured distance from two things a measured distance apart and nudge until the bracket sits on them. It is remembered.

    The scope

    Range-find the flag first to get the real distance, set it below, then use the scope to picture the target. The scope shows you how wide the target is. It measures nothing and records nothing.

    Line it up, see what sits behind the edges on the range, and use those as the target for the session.
